# PendulumRodBeta { #climatecritters.PendulumRodBeta }

```python
PendulumRodBeta(m, L, damping=0.0, forcing=None)
```

Properties of one rod in a :class:`MultiPendulumBeta` chain.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**m**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Bob mass (kg or dimensionless). Must be > 0.

<code>[**L**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Rod length (m or dimensionless). Must be > 0.

<code>[**damping**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Linear joint-damping coefficient applied to this rod. Must be >= 0.

<code>[**forcing**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[object](`object`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Optional external torque term for this rod. May be a constant, callable, or ``cc.Forcing``-like object with ``get_forcing``.

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

``forcing`` is resolved at runtime using the same contract as
:class:`CCModel` parameters, so constants, ``lambda t: ...`` callables,
``lambda t, state: ...`` callables, and forcing objects are all accepted.
